map.根据房屋总价与首付比例测算首付金额、贷款额度及月供: Estimate the down payment, loan amount and monthly payment from the total price and the down payment ratio
map.📖 查看「首付贷款测算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Down Payment and Loan Estimator User Guide"
map.首付 = 总价 × 首付比例: Down payment = total price × down payment ratio
map.= P/n + P×(1 - 已还期数/n)×r（逐月递减）: = P/n + P × (1 − periods repaid/n) × r (falling each month)
map.其中 P=贷款本金，r=月利率，n=还款总月数: where P = loan principal, r = monthly rate and n = total number of monthly payments
map.注：实际贷款额度与利率以银行审批为准，本工具仅供参考。: Note: the actual loan amount and rate depend on bank approval; this tool is reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：首付与贷款测算: 📚 In-depth: Down Payment and Loan Estimation
map.购房前按总价和首付比例算贷款额与月供。: Work out the loan amount and monthly payment from total price and down payment ratio before buying.
map.对比等额本息与等额本金月供压力。: Compare the monthly burden of equal installment and equal principal.
map.二套高首付比例下的现金流测算。: Model cash flow under the higher down payment ratio for a second home.
map.总价 300 万、首付 30% → 首付 90 万、贷款 210 万；30 年、: Total price of 3 million yuan at 30% down gives a down payment of 900,000 and a loan of 2.1 million; over 30 years at 4.2% a year the equal-installment payment is about 10,288 yuan and total interest about 1.6 million.
map.同样 300 万、首付 50% → 贷款 150 万，等额本息月供≈7,349: On the same 3 million yuan at 50% down the loan is 1.5 million and the equal-installment payment about 7,349 yuan, about 2940 yuan a month less than the first-home case but 600,000 yuan more upfront.
map.首付比例最低多少？: What is the minimum down payment ratio?
map.首套普遍 20%–30%、二套 40%–50%，具体看城市限购与贷款政策，且受评: First homes are generally 20%-30% and second homes 40%-50%, depending on city purchase restrictions and lending policy, and on the appraised value.
map.月供占收入多少安全？: What share of income is a safe monthly payment?
map.一般建议月供不超过家庭月收入 50%，更稳妥在 30% 以内，预留生活与风险储备: Payments are generally advised below 50% of household monthly income, and more safely within 30%, leaving room for living costs and a risk buffer.
